cases.continuation_text: The TARGET record has key ORCHID-731. Its location is the west annex, its item count is 47, and its status is held for review. These four values belong to the explicitly marked target record. Ordinary archive records provide background and use their own entry numbers, module labels, counts, and statuses. Their values should not replace the target values. The target marker identifies which record the question asks about, even when other records appear nearby or contain similar fields. The status held for review indicates that this record is waiting for review; it does not say that the items are ready for dispatch or that a review has already finished. The location west annex names a place but does not give a street address or a room number. The item count is 47, and no unit weight or total package count is stated. A reliable extraction keeps the key attached to these exact facts and leaves unstated fields unknown. Checking the record marker first and then reading each named field prevents a nearby record from supplying the wrong count or status. The answer should preserve the spelling of ORCHID-731 so that another person can find the same record in the archive.
